verdict.rationale: Better Stack refers to an incident timeline that feeds automated post-mortems alongside Slack content, and states that all incident events are synced automatically between Slack and the dashboard. Together these suggest alerts, actions and chat activity are captured automatically, and the error-message and screenshot recording adds alert context. Missing for 10: any documentation that the timeline can be edited or annotated afterwards, explicit description of what the timeline records (e.g. chat decisions vs. only Slack-triggered actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
